text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Seriously...? I was so looking 
forward to this...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
You know "Bakusou Punch Pakati" that I 
read every week? Apparently, the author 
got tendonitis, so it's on hiatus.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
And right at the best part, too~ The 
heated battle of our hero, Pakati!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if teaching them my training 
routine would help beat their 
tendonitis...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Like this, for example! Lifting heavy 
things around the room instead of 
dumbbells!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! The armrest of the sofa snapped off! 
I'm so sorry, Trainer!
